text:
The change selects jobs that fit the available paper, taking shorter jobs first and ordering equal-length jobs by submission time.

Double-sided sheet counts round down for odd page counts. I confirmed that a three-page job is selected with only one sheet available, and a one-page job is selected with zero sheets. The new double-sided test uses only even page counts, so it misses this bug.
